title: Ukraine Launches Largest-Ever Drone Attack on Moscow Oblast Amid Duma Elections
detail: Ukraine carried out its largest-ever combined drone/missile strike package against Moscow Oblast overnight September 19-20, striking a major oil refinery and a logistics facility on the final day of voting in Russia's State Duma elections. The regional governor said three people were killed — two in the attack and one who died later in hospital — and 20 others, including three children, were injured. Moscow's mayor claimed the attack was repelled. President Zelenskyy said the targeted facilities were bringing in "billions of dollars that sustain the war machine."

media.caption: Ukraine's largest-ever drone attack strikes a Moscow-area oil refinery on the final day of Russia's Duma elections, Sept. 20, 2026

title: Ukraine Liberates Shandryholove, Derylove in Operation Vivaldi's Second Phase
detail: Ukraine's 3rd Army Corps, commanded by Brigadier General Andrii Biletskyi, announced on September 20 that it liberated the settlements of Shandryholove and Derylove and established full control of Drobysheve in the Lyman sector of Donetsk Oblast during the second phase of offensive operation "Vivaldi." Ukrainian troops regained roughly 40 square kilometers of territory in this phase, bringing the operation's total to 125 square kilometers regained (50 sq km fully liberated) across both stages. Russia's elite Rubicon drone unit reportedly suffered heavy losses and was withdrawn from the northern Donetsk front line; overall Russian losses in the operation have exceeded 3,000 personnel, per the 3rd Army Corps.

media.caption: Ukrainian forces liberate Shandryholove and Derylove in Operation Vivaldi's second phase, Donetsk Oblast, Sept. 20, 2026

title: Russian Drone Strikes Kill Mother, Two Children and Another Girl in Kyiv Region
detail: An overnight Russian drone attack on Kyiv Oblast killed a mother and her two 3-year-old children when a drone struck their private home; a separate strike elsewhere in the region killed another girl who died later in hospital. The southwestern Fastiv district was hit hardest, with more than 24 sites damaged including homes, industrial and utility buildings, an agricultural enterprise and vehicles. Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko reported one person injured in the capital from falling drone fragments. Kyiv region governor Tymur Tkachenko said the region endured more than a day of continuous hostile attacks across multiple districts. Russia made no acknowledgment of the strikes.

media.caption: A mother and her two children were among four killed in Russian drone strikes on Kyiv Oblast, Sept. 20, 2026
